description: The chart illustrates the ratio percentages for three categories - Movies, Songs, and Basketball - across three different models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Ratio (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT. For Movies, the bars are approximately 90% for Llama3 and Qwen2, and 72% for ChatGPT. For Songs, the values are around 83% for Llama3, 90% for Qwen2, and 60% for ChatGPT. For Basketball, the ratios are about 68% for Llama3, 58% for Qwen2, and 60% for ChatGPT. The bars are grouped by category, with the models differentiated by color, and are not sorted in any particular order within the groups. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
